requirement: Pressure vessels shall undergo internal inspection at least once every 5 years or as per statutory requirement.
Storage tanks handling flammable liquids shall have functional relief valves tested annually.
All hoists, lifts and pressure plants shall be periodically examined by a competent person.
Rotating equipment in hydrocarbon service shall have vibration monitoring records maintained.
Boilers shall be subjected to hydraulic test and internal inspection annually by authorized inspector.
